description: Home Assistant entity state via its prometheus integration: automations, gas, ACs, lights, presence.

panels.title: Gas left
panels.description: Two-phase mass in the 45 kg cylinder (sensor.gas_restante).

panels.title: ACs on
panels.description: Air conditioners whose HVAC mode isn't off.

panels.title: Lights on
panels.description: Lamps on (the velador's group and zone entities are left out so it counts once).

panels.title: Automation runs
panels.description: All automations, over the selected range.

panels.title: Runs per automation
panels.description: Runs in the selected range, zeros included: an automation stuck at 0 for weeks is worth a look.

panels.title: Last run
panels.description: When each automation last ran (1-minute resolution). Empty = not in the selected range.

panels.title: Runs per group
panels.description: Grouped by the alias prefix (Aires, Gas, Luces adentro…).

panels.title: Runs per hour
panels.description: Stacked by automation.

panels.title: Burn rate
panels.description: Linear trend over the last 7 days.

panels.title: Days left
panels.description: Until the liquid runs out (~1.6 kg of vapour remain), at the 7-day burn rate. A refill inside the window throws it off until it slides out.

panels.title: Gas left
panels.description: Dashed lines: the low (10 kg) and critical (6 kg) alerts.

panels.title: Liquid height
panels.description: The Mopeka's raw reading and the two filters in packages/gas.yaml.

panels.title: Hours on per AC
panels.description: Time in any mode but off, over the selected range (SmartIR: the mode HA last sent).

panels.title: Hours per mode
panels.description: All ACs together.

targets.expr: sum by (friendly_name) (homeassistant_climate_mode{mode="heat"} or homeassistant_climate_mode{mode="cool"} * 2 or homeassistant_climate_mode{mode="dry"} * 3 or homeassistant_climate_mode{mode="fan_only"} * 4 or homeassistant_climate_mode{mode="heat_cool"} * 5)

panels.title: Temperatures
panels.description: Room thermometers, the outside temperature, and each AC's setpoint while it's on.

panels.title: Hours on per light
panels.description: Over the selected range. Lamps that are unavailable (unplugged at the wall) count as off.

panels.title: Presence
panels.description: Pi-hole based presence (packages/presencia.yaml), the kids' nights, guests and the presence simulation.

panels.title: Hours on
panels.description: Over the selected range.

panels.title: PC and washer-dryer
panels.description: Gaps are the washer's Wi-Fi asleep (unavailable).

panels.title: Washer-dryer cycles
panels.description: Starts in the selected range.

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: HA restarts in the selected range (each package change in git rolls the pod).

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Resident memory (limit 1 GiB).

panels.title: Chattiest entities
panels.description: State changes in the selected range: what fills the recorder.

panels.title: State changes by domain
panels.description: Per minute.
